evals.prompt: Design a multi-tenant Apps Script CRM for 80 small businesses using Sheets. Users can belong to two businesses and each tenant has plan limits.
evals.expected_output: A trusted membership model, topology tradeoff, tenant-scoped repositories/cache/jobs/audit, role and entitlement matrix, lifecycle, concurrency-safe metering, tests, and migration threshold.

evals.prompt: Audit our shared-sheet SaaS. The browser sends tenantId, queries filter by it, and ScriptCache stores customer lists using the key 'customers'.
evals.expected_output: High-priority cross-tenant findings, server-derived context, mandatory resource ownership checks, partitioned caching, job/export coverage, regression tests, and residual risk of shared Sheets.
